articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning and 1M Token Context
articles.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5 Turbo in early August, featuring a natively multimodal architecture that unifies text, image, audio, and video understanding in a single forward pass rather than relying on adapter modules. The model demonstrates significant gains on graduate-level science benchmarks and agentic coding tasks, while reducing inference costs by roughly 40% compared to the original GPT-5 release thanks to a new mixture-of-experts routing scheme.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Complex Multi-Step Agent Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind unveiled Gemini Ultra 2, which tops the newly released GAIA-2 and WebArena-Hard benchmarks for autonomous tool-using agents. The model introduces a persistent scratchpad memory mechanism that lets it maintain coherent plans across hundreds of sequential tool calls, marking a step change in reliable long-horizon task completion for enterprise automation workflows.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 Herd with 400B MoE Model and Multilingual Specialization
articles.summary: Meta released the full Llama 4 model family under a permissive open license, headlined by a 400B-parameter mixture-of-experts model that activates roughly 52B parameters per token. The release includes language-specialized expert shards for over 100 languages and a distillation toolkit, enabling the open-source community to fine-tune competitive domain-specific models on consumer-grade multi-GPU setups.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Automotive and Warehouse Facilities
articles.summary: Tesla confirmed that its third-generation Optimus humanoid robot has entered limited production deployment at three of its own manufacturing plants and two partner logistics warehouses. Gen 3 features redesigned actuators providing 30% more payload capacity and a new vision-language-action model that allows operators to issue natural-language task instructions, reducing task programming time from hours to minutes.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Commercial Platform for Industrial Inspection
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics officially launched the commercial Atlas platform targeting industrial inspection in oil and gas, utilities, and heavy manufacturing. The electric humanoid robot can autonomously navigate catwalks, climb ladders, and use standard handheld instruments, powered by an onboard multimodal perception stack that fuses lidar, thermal, and visual data for real-time anomaly detection and digital twin updates.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm A14 Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced that its A14 (1.4nm-class) process has entered high-volume manufacturing at its Kaohsiung fab, several months ahead of its original timeline. The node uses gate-all-around nanosheet transistors with backside power delivery, delivering approximately 25% better performance and 35% lower power at iso-speed compared to N2, with key AI accelerator customers expected to tape out by Q4 2026.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Expanded Access Approval for Motor-Impairment BCI in 50 Patients
articles.summary: The FDA granted Neuralink an expanded access protocol allowing its N2 brain-computer interface implant to be used in up to 50 patients with severe motor impairments such as ALS and spinal cord injuries. Early clinical data from the initial cohort showed participants achieving cursor control speeds approaching able-bodied benchmarks, with the device's on-chip spike sorting enabling over 3,000 simultaneously recorded channels.

articles.title: Figure AI and BMW Expand Humanoid Robot Deployment Across Five European Assembly Plants
articles.summary: Figure AI announced a major expansion of its partnership with BMW, deploying its Figure 02 humanoid robots across five European assembly plants for tasks including parts kitting, quality inspection, and sub-assembly insertion. The robots leverage a new foundation world model trained on over 50,000 hours of factory teleoperation data, enabling zero-shot generalization to previously unseen part geometries and bin configurations.
